# Darshil Jain

> BBA (Business & Industry) student at Maharaja Surajmal Institute, GGSIPU, Delhi, working across operations, strategy and people. Three internships, a paid startup consulting engagement and a student club built from zero to 80+ members.

Darshil Jain is a BBA (Business & Industry) student at Maharaja Surajmal Institute, affiliated with Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (GGSIPU), in Janakpuri, Delhi. Class of 2027, CGPA 9.39. Darshil works across operations, strategy and people.

Darshil has interned in operations at Figmenta and PSR Compliance and in human resources at MJ Marketing Consultancy: screening 500+ résumés, running compliance workflows for 70+ clients and coordinating 100+ interviews. Darshil also consulted for the AI healthcare startup ZautoAI on a paid engagement that helped it become a finalist at IIHMR Saamarthya 5.0.

Darshil founded the institute's Igniters Club chapter (powered by Unstop), grew it from 0 to 80+ members in 10 months and led Converge 2026, the institute's largest management fest, with 1,000+ participants and ₹50,000+ in sponsorship and partnership value.

Every figure on this site comes from Darshil Jain's own one-page résumé and is marked self-reported where it cannot be independently verified.

## Frequently asked questions

### Who is Darshil Jain?

Darshil Jain is a BBA (Business & Industry) student at Maharaja Surajmal Institute (GGSIPU) in Delhi, class of 2027, working across operations, strategy and people. Darshil has interned at Figmenta, PSR Compliance and MJ Marketing Consultancy and founded the institute's Igniters Club chapter.

### What does Darshil Jain study?

A Bachelor of Business Administration in Business & Industry at Maharaja Surajmal Institute, affiliated with Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, from 2024 to 2027, with a CGPA of 9.39.

### Where has Darshil Jain interned?

Figmenta (Operations Intern, Jan–Feb 2026), PSR Compliance (Operations Intern, June–August 2025) and MJ Marketing Consultancy (Human Resource Intern, March–June 2025, with a letter of recommendation).

### What has Darshil Jain led?

Darshil founded the Igniters Club chapter (powered by Unstop) at the institute in September 2025, grew it to 80+ members with a 17-member leadership team, and led Converge 2026: 1,000+ participants and ₹50,000+ in sponsorship and partnership value.

### What has Darshil Jain won?

Winner of the BPlan Showdown business plan competition, finalist at the 13th National Business Plan Championship (IIM Bangalore × MakeIntern), 4th place in Product Decode (IIM Calcutta) and top 10% of participants in the IIT Guwahati Consulting & Analytics Club Winter Consulting Program.
